status: Mechanistic secondary analysis designed after the validation-only quotient result. Not a new preregistered discovery or an untouched physical release.
question: Does a four-symbol code of the full block predict individual registered face species at buffer two, and can it outperform a site-additive or exactly optimized two-corner code with the same type of categorical readout?

geometry.source: l20-16384-v1 independent preparation endpoints, uint8 z,y,x on a periodic L=20 cube. No new configurations, trajectories or MCMC. Compressed NPZ integrity compared with endpoint sidecar before using allowed folds.
geometry.visible: 27 ordered species in [-1,1]^3 about a uniformly translated center, z-major order, x fastest.
geometry.target: 54 ordered individual exterior species: axis z,y,x then sign -,+ then transverse offsets [-1,1]^2 (remaining axes in z,y,x order). Signed normal coordinate +/-(b+2). Exactly b intervening lattice layers. Same projections and translation streams at all buffers.
geometry.split: examples/l20_pairs.py:partition(index), seed 769315, 10240 train, 2048 validation, 4096 test parents per beta. Numerical observations in a compressed species member are selected by split prior to transfer or species inspection. Every permitted parent is checked for identical species composition.

estimand.unit: nats per uniformly chosen exterior pixel (NOT nats per entire shell)
estimand.bound: B = (1/54) sum_j E_{V,Y_j} sum_h pi(h|V) log(q_j(Y_j|h)/p(Y_j)). For uniform lattice translation the exact p_s is the fixed count n_s/8000 at every j, regardless of beta. This equals H(p) + mean_j E log q_j(Y_j|H), and differs from mean_j I(H;Y_j) by minus the mean conditional KL. It therefore also lower-bounds I(H;the 54-vector), and I(H;the whole shell) by data processing. Never multiply by 54. A held-out estimate has sampling uncertainty and can be negative.
estimand.numerics: Center by log p(Y_j) per example rather than adding H(p) to a noisy empirical log score. Exact control-variate identity under translation; static marginal decoder scores zero observation-by-observation. No InfoNCE or negative-pair normalization. Sum over the four actual alphabet outcomes analytically, and average all registered j rather than randomly subsampling them. No decoder sees pi or logits as predictor features: only a four-state conditional probability lookup at each j.
estimand.scope: Unlike quotient.py, this is an average of 54 one-site predictions, not a joint two-site target aligned with two corners. Neither the values nor a non-detection can be equated to the earlier joint projection. Improvement over an alternative is a difference of achieved predictive lower bounds, not a bound on a difference of true MIs.

operators.additive: Stochastic softmax of four independent, untied 27-site ternary one-hot additive logits, centered at p. Spatial and species selectivity, including signs and opposite corners, allowed.
operators.full_soft: Same additive skip plus 64 hidden SiLU units on the entire centered raw block. A genuinely stochastic four-state channel; conditional log probabilities averaged over the four states exactly.
operators.full_hard: Same nonlinear architecture; exact one-hot argmax in every forward pass; use straight-through softmax derivative in training only.
operators.isotropic: Fixed rotation/reflection invariant two bits: vacancy count and A-count in the block above their fixed-composition mean. Not a claim that these features span all isotropic physics.
operators.corner: Choose all the way over the 4 opposite-corner pairs and all 7770 four-cell unlabeled partitions of the 9 raw species pairs on each diagonal. Exact maximum of the exponentially weighted empirical train average per-site conditional log likelihood under unrestricted lookup q (ties ordered by diagonal/partition), not a claim about non-opposite pairs. Four cells suffice because refinement cannot lower fitted MI. Same train translations as neural arms, no validation to select a map or temperature-specific refitting at test.
operators.initialization: Matched linear skip initialized with distributed random weights plus weak opposite-corner A-bit structure; nonlinear residual final layer starts at zero. Train-only bonus 0.0005 times (1-step/128)_+ times [H(H)-max(0,0.25-I(H;V))], using batch moments, discourages both dead states and a balanced but input-independent code. Explicitly report p(H), exp(H(H)), H(H|V), I(H;V) and flag min p_h<.01 or I(H;V)<.01; no exclusion or rescue based on validation or test.
operators.interpretation: Validation/test conditional ternary species profiles at each of the 27 visible sites, in the learned code's own label order, plus learned corner map. Code labels are arbitrary across fits.

fitting.sampling: One seed/buffer cell per invocation at index 9. Same uniformly drawn distinct training parents and uniform wrapped anchors for every arm in an update. Same seed gives common observations across buffers; within each validation/test beta, all cells share a separate fixed evaluation stream (independent of model seed/buffer). Evaluation with 8000 anchors visits all translations exactly once.
fitting.updates: Learned encoders maximize the enumerated bound using Adam, .002 default, fp32, TF32 disabled. All readouts are the same conditional 4 x 54 x 3 lookup estimated by expected counts; online exponential discount 1-1/1024 and 64 observations of marginal prior per (h,j). The corner optimizer only pools train sufficient statistics. At the final step freeze all encoders/maps, reset lookup counts and refit all decoders on the same fresh stream of train-only observations with no discount and the same prior. This separate equal-exposure pass removes moving-encoder staleness. No neural negative-pair critic.
fitting.staging: Proposed economical screen: steps=512, batch=2048, eval_anchors=64, calibrate_steps=256; use the same seed 68239 in separate b=2,1,3 directories. Candidate deepen on the unchanged cell: steps=4096 absolute, calibrate_steps=1024, eval_anchors=256. Additional fixed common seeds and budget decisions, if any, are search not replication or confirmation. Curves at online checkpoints are not calibrated final scores.
fitting.reproducibility: Checkpoint stores source/code/config identity, model, optimizer, step, batch-generator state, CPU/CUDA RNG and curve via same-directory atomic rename. Deepening resumes the pre-calibration training trajectory; all terminal readouts are calibrated on a separate generator. Interrupted final calibration/measurement is restarted deterministically from the last training checkpoint. Explicit finite steps and absolute --end-epoch (default 1795556725). Hardware/driver numerical equivalence is not asserted.

controls_and_inference.shuffle: Within 64 distinct same-beta parents rotate complete target vectors by 32 parents with no fixed point. Evaluate every frozen arm on natural and shuffled targets on identical anchors; separately train a matched nonlinear stochastic arm only on shuffled targets. Blocks never share shuffled data.
controls_and_inference.power: In the first 8/64 members per shuffled chunk, for each j reorder existing labels to rank-match A-presence at the first visible corner. All donors are disjoint from recipients. Preserve every individual position's target histogram exactly. Synthetic associations only; the 54-vector no longer represents a physical shell. Train a matched nonlinear stochastic plant arm and evaluate its injected-minus-shuffled score with paired block intervals. Report local approximate one-sided 5%-level/80%-power minimum detectable changes of raw and paired scores, (t_0.95+z_0.80)*block SE. These quantify precision conditional on the fitted readout and observed block variance; injection recovery does not establish power for every weaker natural signal.
controls_and_inference.validation: Report raw, shuffled, planted, paired natural-minus-shuffled (planted-minus-shuffled for the plant arm), and paired raw differences versus additive, isotropic and exact edge-of-block opposite-corner controls. Retain every parent-block score. Select better final calibrated raw validation score of full_soft/full_hard (ties favor soft); not the arm giving largest margin over baselines. A collapsed or losing code remains in the report. Validation curves and rankings are descriptive after search.
controls_and_inference.confirmation: Operator, all readouts and comparators from a single selected search cell are frozen. Record frozen artifact digest, selected arm and test resolution before reading test species; test the same cold model unchanged across index 9,7,0. No new fitting, thresholding or selection on test. Only one chosen nonlinear model, not a new winner at each temperature. Repeated confirmation of alternate cells on the same test parents is not independent confirmation. Index 0 at exactly fixed composition need not have literally zero MI.
controls_and_inference.uncertainty: Within each beta, summarize 32 disjoint validation or 64 disjoint test blocks of 64 original parents. Equal parent/anchor contributions; repeated translations, pixels and optimizer seeds are not independent samples. Paired differences before a two-sided Student t interval over blocks. Nominal pointwise intervals, conditional on frozen fits; no familywise claim across buffers, models, temperatures or diagnostics. Primary summary is index-9 b2 raw per-site bound and paired gaps, b1/b3 and temperature transfer are calibration/diagnostics.
